Name: GMCM Text Fit
Author: Sxdic
Description:
[center][size=4][b]GMCM Text Fit[/b][/size]
[size=2]Long option names in Generic Mod Config Menu stop running under the checkbox.[/size][/center]
[line]
[b][size=3][color=#8bc34a]What it does[/color][/size][/b]
[size=2]In Generic Mod Config Menu, every checkbox, list and slider sits in the middle of its row, no matter how long the name next to it is. Long names, which are common in translations, run right underneath them and become hard to read.[/size]

[size=2]With this mod, each menu is rearranged when it opens. The options line up right after the names, and a dotted line joins each name to its option, so you always know which is which. A name that still doesn't fit breaks into two lines, with its option centered next to it.[/size]

[size=2]Nothing in other mods or their translations changes, and it works on the menu of every mod that uses Generic Mod Config Menu.[/size]

[size=2]I made it for my Brazilian Portuguese translations, where option names often end up much longer than in English.[/size]
[line]
[b][size=3][color=#8bc34a]Settings[/color][/size][/b]
[size=2]In Generic Mod Config Menu, under GMCM Text Fit:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Enabled[/b]: off brings back the usual menus[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Where the options go[/b]: after the longest name (default), at the right edge, right after each name, or in the middle as usual[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Guide[/b]: a dotted line from each name to its option (default), stripes on every other option, or nothing[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]Changes show the next time you open a menu. The mod's texts come in English and Brazilian Portuguese.[/size]
[line]
[b][size=3][color=#8bc34a]Requirements[/color][/size][/b]
[size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/size]
[line]
[b][size=3][color=#8bc34a]Installation[/color][/size][/b]
[size=2]Unzip into your Mods folder.[/size]
[line]
[b][size=3][color=#8bc34a]Compatibility[/color][/size][/b]
[size=2]Works with any mod that has a Generic Mod Config Menu page, and with GMCM Options. It doesn't change Generic Mod Config Menu's files. If a future version of Generic Mod Config Menu changes its menus in a way this mod doesn't understand, the mod stays out of the way and says so in the SMAPI console; the menus just look as usual.[/size]
[line]
[b][size=3][color=#8bc34a]Uninstall[/color][/size][/b]
[size=2]Delete the GMCM Text Fit folder from Mods.[/size]
[line]
[b][size=3][color=#8bc34a]Permissions[/color][/size][/b]
[size=2]Please don't re-upload it; link to this page instead.[/size]

[b]Author:[/b] Sxdic
